AddElement.description: Adds a paragraph or a table or a blockLvl content control using its position in the document content.

params.description: The position where the current element will be added.
params.name: nPos

params.description: The document element which will be added at the current position.
params.name: oElement

AddPage.description: Adds a new page to document.

params.description: The index where the page will be added.
params.name: index

params.description: The page width.
params.name: width

params.description: The page height.
params.name: height

AddPage.signature: AddPage(index?: number, width?: pt, height?: pt): ApiPage

AddText.description: Appends the specified text to the end of the document content.

params.description: The text to add.
params.name: text

GetAllFields.description: Gets list of all fields in document.

GetAllParagraphs.description: Returns an array of all paragraphs from the current document content.

GetClassType.description: Returns a type of the ApiDocument class.

GetCurrentParagraph.description: Returns the current paragraph where the cursor is located.

GetCurrentRun.description: Returns the current run where the cursor is located.

GetElement.description: Returns an element by its position in the document.

params.description: The element position that will be taken from the document.
params.name: nPos

GetElementsCount.description: Returns a number of elements in the current document.

params.description: the full name parameter.
params.name: name

GetInternalId.description: Returns an internal ID of the current document content.

GetPage.description: Gets page by index from document.

params.description: page index.
params.name: index

GetSelectionQuads.description: Gets document selection quads by page

GetStyle.description: Returns the document style by its name.

params.description: The name of the table style to look up.
params.name: sStyleName

GetText.description: Returns the inner text of the current document content object.

params.description: Options for formatting the returned text.
params.name: options

params.description: Defines if the resulting string will include numbering or not.
params.name: options_Numbering

params.description: Defines if the resulting string will include mathematical expressions or not.
params.name: options_Math

params.description: Defines how the table cell separator will be specified in the resulting string. Any symbol can be used. The default separator is "\t".
params.name: options_TableCellSeparator

params.description: Defines how the table row separator will be specified in the resulting string. Any symbol can be used. The default separator is "\r\n".
params.name: options_TableRowSeparator

params.description: Defines how the paragraph separator will be specified in the resulting string. Any symbol can be used. The default separator is "\r\n".
params.name: options_ParaSeparator

params.description: Defines how the tab will be specified in the resulting string. Any symbol can be used. The default symbol is "\t".
params.name: options_TabSymbol

params.description: Defines how the line separator will be specified in the resulting string. Any symbol can be used. The default separator is "\r".
params.name: options_NewLineSeparator

GetText.signature: GetText(options?: object, options_Numbering?: boolean, options_Math?: boolean, options_TableCellSeparator?: string, options_TableRowSeparator?: string, options_ParaSeparator?: string, options_TabSymbol?: string, options_NewLineSeparator?: string): string

Push.description: Pushes a paragraph or a table to actually add it to the document.

params.description: The element type which will be pushed to the document.
params.name: oElement

returns.description: returns false if oElement is unsupported.

RemoveAllElements.description:
Removes all the elements from the current document or from the current document element.
<note>When all elements are removed, a new empty paragraph is automatically created. If you want to add
content to this paragraph, use the {@link ApiDocumentContent#GetElement} method.</note>

RemoveElement.description: Removes an element using the position specified.

params.description: The element number (position) in the document or inside other element.
params.name: nPos

RemovePage.description:
Removes page by index from document
<note> You can't delete last page </note>

params.description: page index
params.name: index

SearchAndRedact.description: Searchs words and adds redact to it.

params.description: The search options.
params.name: props

params.description: order of fields names
params.name: names

SetText.description:
Replaces all content of the current document content object with the specified text,
preserving the formatting of the first paragraph.

params.description: The text to set.
params.name: text
